messages:
maria: Heads-up — proposing we UNPIN runtime 2.14 from canary tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Kernel patch helps llama3q latency but uncovered an SDK shim mismatch on quantized paths. I want to coordinate rollback criteria and the unpin schedule.

sam: Do we know which model groups hit the shim? Is it only quant-v3 models or more?

maria: quant-v3 and a small slice of quant-v2 longseq. Repro locally with longseq > 4k tokens; errors are decoder OOM in logs.

jen: Can we delay full unpin and instead soft-unpin for canary region-us-west2 only? Keep prod pinned until we validate rollback plan.

kai: Agree for phased approach. IF canary error rate > 0.5% OR p95 generation latency increases > 200ms versus baseline, we trigger rollback to runtime 2.13. Rollback runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/runtime-rollback (see steps 1-3).

olivia: Confirm maintenance window and external comms. If we unpin, will customers in Dedicated see any routing changes?

maria: No routing changes expected. This is a runtime pin toggle inside deploybot pinlist; Dedicated pools keep pinned runtime until we push an explicit config. We'll notify customers with dedicated capacity via internal sales slack and update the console notice.

deploy-bot: pinlist update scheduled by maria: runtime=2.14 -> UNPIN for region=us-west2 canary at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Command used: `/deploy pin runtime 2.14 --scope=region:us-west2 --action=unpin --at=2026-03-21T02:00Z`

sam: Quick QA checklist for canary: 1) smoke tests for longseq, 2) perf tests (1000 reqs/min) with quant-v3, 3) KV cache sanity. I'll own the perf job.

jen: I'll update release notes and add a compatibility note: "Runtime 2.14 contains kernel changes that may surface SDK shim mismatches for quantized models; recommended fallback: runtime 2.13."

kai: Monitoring hooks: create an alert for `runtime.errors.rate > 0.5%` and `p95_gen_lat_increase > 200ms` scoped to region-us-west2 and model-group quant-v3/quant-v2-longseq. I wired dashboards and will slack the pager channel if thresholds breach.

maria: Thanks. Small automation note — if rollback triggers, deploy-bot please run: `/deploy rollback runtime 2.13 --scope=region:us-west2 --reason="shim-mismatch-detected"` and mark the incident in the rollout ticket.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Rollback action template stored at /ops/templates/rollback-runtime.json. I will post status updates during the window.

olivia: I'll prepare a short postmortem template in case we need it, and coordinate customer notifications.

maria: Plan approved. Staging -> canary unpin scheduled for 2026-03-21T02:00Z (us-west2). Prod hold for now. If canary looks good for 24h, we'll schedule prod unpin in next change window. Will post final checklist 1h before window. :white_check_mark:
